title: Infra: site.json-driven app shell (no PAT), CMS prod+staging, reader app, build specs on packages
description:
## Goal
Turn the single-site Pilobol.us app-shell CDK into the standard `@anthusai/papyrus/infra`: driven by the publication's own `infra/site.json`, no access token, a CMS app with `main` (production, owns the backend) and `staging` branches, an optional static reader app, generated build specs that use the published packages (and Python 3.12), per-site naming, and the staging/rebuild permissions the other Phase 2 tickets need. Synth-verified here; the real deploy and reconnect are Phase 3.

## Context (verified against origin/develop a10609d)
- `infra/amplify-app-shell/`: `bin/app-shell.ts` (CDK app; `resolveSite(-c site=...)` from `sites/pilobol-us.ts`; env hardcoded account `335163751677`, `us-east-1`), `lib/amplify-app-shell.ts` (`AmplifyAppShellStack`: `CfnApp` with `repository` + `accessToken: SecretValue.secretsManager(config.githubTokenSecretName).unsafeUnwrap()` (the PAT, conflict C4), one `CfnBranch` `main`, `CfnDomain`, service role with `AdministratorAccess`, compute role, an inlined build spec that runs `npm install` and `npx ampx pipeline-deploy`), `sites/pilobol-us.ts` (type `AmplifyAppShellSiteConfig` + the Pilobol entry with `githubTokenSecretName`, `repository: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus`, `hostedZoneId Z09961547QX1VHIXOBD7`, env vars incl. `PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS`).
- Package build: `packages/papyrus/scripts/stage.mjs` "infra" block (L131-155) extracts the site type with a regex from `sites/pilobol-us.ts`, concatenates it with the construct source into `infra/amplify-app-shell.ts` and transpiles; `packages/papyrus/bin/papyrus-infra.mjs` (`papyrus-infra synth --site infra/site.json [--out] [--account] [--region]`) instantiates `AmplifyAppShellStack(app, "AmplifyAppShell-<siteId>", config, ...)`; `infra/index.js` fails with a clear message when the optional peers `aws-cdk-lib`/`constructs` are missing (spike result (g) PASS).
- Spike findings still open here: finding 3 (Amplify AL2023 build image defaults to Python 3.10 (AWS docs; not verified on a real build) while `papyrus-newsroom` needs >=3.12), finding 5 (infra/ app is 990 MB because the package lists all runtime deps; ACCEPTED, no infra-only entry: YAGNI), finding 9 (build specs from the shell need verification on Amplify).
- Existing `site-backend.ts` config already takes per-site input (`PapyrusSiteBackendConfig` in `amplify/site-backend-config.ts`: `brandId`, `productionAppId`, `auth: { redirectUrls, disableGoogleOAuth, cognitoDomainPrefix }`, `features`). `docs/standard-site.md` 1.6 defines naming: `<site-id>-cms`, `<site-id>-reader`; stack `amplify-app-shell-<site-id>`; `newsroom.<domain>` (CMS), `staging.<domain>` (staging), apex (reader).
- Repo connection reality (from `Anth.us-Papyrus` AGENTS.md on origin/main, lines ~161-163, 278-322): Amplify's GitHub App connection needs a one-time console handshake ("Amplify -> app -> Hosting -> Connect repository"); there is no API. An app created without `repository`/token is a manual-deploy app until connected.

## Exact changes
1. Config schema (`infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/site-config.ts`, new, real TypeScript source; `stage.mjs` copies it instead of regex-extracting): 
   ```ts
   export type AmplifyAppShellSiteConfig = {
     siteId: string;                       // kebab-case; names + stack suffix
     repository: string;                   // https://github.com/AnthusAI/<repo>; informational (connection is a console step)
     brand: string;                        // PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND
     frontend: "pretext" | "markus-static";
     hostedZoneId: string;
     cms: { appName?: string; domainName: string; buildComputeType?: "STANDARD" | "STANDARD_8GB"; environment: Record<string, string>; stagingDomainName?: string };
     reader?: { appName?: string; domainName: string; branchName?: string; buildCommand: string; baseDirectory: string; environment?: Record<string, string> };  // required when frontend === "markus-static"
     papyrusVersion: string;               // exact @anthusai/papyrus version (also pins pip papyrus-newsroom==...)
     storagePreviewPrefix?: string;        // default "preview/"
   };
   export function parseSiteConfig(raw: unknown): AmplifyAppShellSiteConfig   // throws a message naming the bad field
   ```
   Delete `sites/pilobol-us.ts` and `bin/app-shell.ts` from the package path; keep a repo-local `infra/amplify-app-shell/sites/` ONLY as `examples/pilobol-us.site.json` (copy of today's values with the PAT field removed) and make `bin/app-shell.ts` read `-c site=<path-to-json>`.
2. `lib/amplify-app-shell.ts`: remove `SecretValue`, `githubTokenSecretName`, `accessToken` and `repository` from `CfnApp` (no repo, no token). Create: CMS app `WEB_COMPUTE` (`cms.appName ?? "<siteId>-cms"`) with branches `main` (`stage: PRODUCTION`, `PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND`, `SITE_ENV=production`, `PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE=published`, plus `cms.environment`) and `staging` (`stage: BETA`, `SITE_ENV=staging`, and `PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE=drafts` for `pretext` or `PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW=static` for `markus-static`, plus `NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_STAGING_URL`); domain associations `newsroom.<domain>` -> `main` and `staging.<domain>` -> `staging`; for `markus-static` a second app `WEB` (`reader.appName ?? "<siteId>-reader"`) with branch `main` and its domain. Add `OAuth` origins: the stack outputs the three origins; `cms.environment.PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS` must include `https://newsroom.<domain>/`, `https://staging.<domain>/` and `http://localhost:3001/` (validate in `parseSiteConfig`).
3. Build specs generated in code (functions `cmsProductionBuildSpec(config)`, `cmsStagingBuildSpec(config)`, `readerBuildSpec(config)`), set as the app `buildSpec` and `CfnBranch.buildSpec` for `staging`:
   - CMS production: `backend: npm ci` (NOT `npm install`; spike finding 4) then `npx ampx pipeline-deploy --branch $AWS_BRANCH --app-id $AWS_APP_ID`; `frontend: npx papyrus-app sync && npm run build`; artifacts `.next`.
   - CMS staging: NO `backend:` phase; `frontend.preBuild`: `npm ci`, `npx ampx generate outputs --branch main --app-id <production app id>` (the frontend-only/staging pattern from spike (h); app id from `$AWS_APP_ID` of the CMS app, branch `main`); for `markus-static` run the staging export/build/upload steps from `PPY-f00c89` item 5 (python3.12 provisioning below); then `npx papyrus-app sync && npm run build`.
   - Reader (`markus-static`): provision Python 3.12 (the AL2023 image defaults to 3.10: install `uv` with the official installer, `uv python install 3.12`, `uv venv --python 3.12 .venv`, `uv pip install --python .venv "papyrus-newsroom[markus]==<papyrusVersion mapped to PEP 440>"`), then `papyrus auth refresh-jwt --write-env .env` (build role reads the SSM secret), `papyrus content export-published --out content-export --clean`, then `reader.buildCommand`; artifacts `reader.baseDirectory`. There is NO `backend:` phase and no `npm run build`.
   - The specs call repo-local entrypoints only; no secrets inline.
4. IAM: replace `AdministratorAccess` on the service role by an inline least-privilege policy for the actions `ampx pipeline-deploy` needs? Investigation is not part of this ticket: keep `AdministratorAccess` for the CMS service role (documented risk), but give the READER service role a narrow policy: `ssm:GetParameter(s)` on `/amplify/*` secrets path of this site, `s3:GetObject` on `arn:aws:s3:::amplify-*/media/*`, `execute-api`/`appsync:GraphQL` is not needed (JWT lane), `amplify:ListJobs/StartJob` not needed. The staging branch build uses the CMS service role (it needs `s3:PutObject`/`DeleteObject` on `preview/*`; already admin).
5. `stage.mjs` infra block: copy `infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/*.ts` as-is (no regex), compile with the same TypeScript step, export `{ AmplifyAppShellStack, parseSiteConfig }` from `infra/index.js`. `papyrus-infra synth` calls `parseSiteConfig`. Add `papyrus-infra print-buildspec --site site.json --app cms-production|cms-staging|reader` (prints the YAML) so specs are reviewable without CDK output parsing.
6. Docs: rewrite `infra/amplify-app-shell/README.md` for the new flow; add `docs/site-hosting.md` "One-time GitHub App connection per app" with the exact click path (below) and the Python 3.12 note; update `publications/pilobol_us/docs/bootstrap.md` only where it contradicts (PAT, floating `main`).

## Data shapes
`infra/site.json` for Pilobol.us (example):
```json
{ "siteId": "pilobol-us", "repository": "https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us", "brand": "pilobol-us", "frontend": "markus-static",
  "hostedZoneId": "Z09961547QX1VHIXOBD7", "papyrusVersion": "1.0.0",
  "cms": { "domainName": "newsroom.pilobol.us", "stagingDomainName": "staging.pilobol.us", "buildComputeType": "STANDARD_8GB",
           "environment": { "PAPYRUS_EDITION_SLUG": "current", "PAPYRUS_ENABLE_CONSOLE_RESPONDER": "false", "PAPYRUS_ENABLE_SLACK": "false",
             "PAPYRUS_ENABLE_INBOUND_EMAIL": "false", "PAPYRUS_ENABLE_STORAGE_BACKUPS": "false", "PAPYRUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX": "papyrus-pilobol-us",
             "PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS": "http://localhost:3001/,https://newsroom.pilobol.us/,https://staging.pilobol.us/" } },
  "reader": { "domainName": "pilobol.us", "buildCommand": "python3 reader/build.py --content content-export --out dist", "baseDirectory": "dist" } }
```
`papyrus-infra synth` output: stack `amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us` with `AWS::Amplify::App` x2, `Branch` x3, `Domain` x3, IAM roles, no `AccessToken` property anywhere (assert).

## Tests
- TS unit `scripts/test-infra-site-config.ts` (tsx): `parseSiteConfig` accepts the example, rejects missing `reader` for `markus-static`, bad `siteId`, redirect URLs missing the staging origin, unknown `frontend`.
- Synth tests `scripts/test-infra-synth.mjs` (node): in a temp dir install the staged tarball + `aws-cdk-lib` + `constructs` (or run against the repo's `infra/amplify-app-shell/node_modules`), run `papyrus-infra synth` for two example configs (`pretext`, `markus-static`), parse `cdk.out/*.template.json` and assert: no `AccessToken`; Pretext config creates 1 app, 2 branches; static config creates 2 apps; staging branch build spec has no `backend:` phase and contains `ampx generate outputs`; reader spec contains `uv python install 3.12` and `papyrus-newsroom[markus]==`; every spec uses `npm ci`; outputs list the app ids.
- Packaging check (extends `PPY-78e818`'s `verify-packages.mjs` or `scripts/test-package-contents.mjs`): the tarball's `infra/` contains `site-config.js`; importing `@anthusai/papyrus/infra` without CDK still fails with the clear message (spike (g)).
- Gherkin: none (infrastructure; verified by synth tests).

## Acceptance checks
- `npx tsx scripts/test-infra-site-config.ts && node scripts/test-infra-synth.mjs` pass.
- `node packages/stage.mjs --version 0.0.0-inf.1 && node packages/verify-packages.mjs 0.0.0-inf.1` pass (after `PPY-78e818`).
- `cd <scratch infra app> && npx papyrus-infra synth --site examples/pilobol-us.site.json` prints `synthesized amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us` and `grep -c AccessToken cdk.out/*.template.json` prints 0.
- NOT done here (Phase 3, Pilobol.us migration): `cdk deploy`, the console connection, and the first Amplify build. State this explicitly in the PR.

## Dependencies
Blocked by `PPY-78e818` (packages exist to depend on; `papyrusVersion`), `PPY-f00c89`/`PPY-3e5e9d` (env var names, build contract) for the staging spec, `PPY-e7f81e` is independent (adds roles to the same stack: serialize edits to `lib/amplify-app-shell.ts`). Blocks Phase 3 (PPY-3367d3) and `PPY-fbb1fb` (reader app id output).

## Risks
- Connecting a repository to an app created without one is only documented for the console flow (Anth.us precedent); an app whose branches were created by CDK before the connection may behave differently once connected (branch auto-build mapping). Prove it on a scratch site with Ryan before Phase 3; if branch creation must happen after connection, move `CfnBranch` creation to a documented post-connect `aws amplify create-branch` step.
- `uv` installer at build time downloads from the network on every build (cache `~/.cache/uv` in the build spec `cache.paths`); alternative is a prebuilt custom build image (not now).
- `ampx generate outputs --branch main --app-id <cms app>` for the staging branch assumes production backend outputs; verified locally in the spike, not on real Amplify (spike (h)).
- Reconnecting the LIVE Pilobol.us CMS app (d11eu9hbs2mipk) must not rebuild its backend; none of this is touched until Phase 3.
- CDK bootstrap/qualifier compatibility between the package's CDK range (`aws-cdk-lib ^2.257`) and the account bootstrap (v32): check at first deploy.

## Needs Ryan (one-time, per site, in Phase 3; written into `docs/site-hosting.md` by this ticket)
Amplify GitHub App connection for each app (CMS and reader), console click path: AWS Console -> AWS Amplify -> All apps -> choose `<siteId>-cms` -> **Hosting** (or "Connect repository" banner) -> **Connect repository** -> **GitHub** -> **Continue** -> in the GitHub pop-up choose **Install & authorize** the **AWS Amplify** GitHub App for the `AnthusAI` organization with access to only the site's repo -> back in Amplify pick repository `AnthusAI/<repo>` and branch `main` -> **Next** -> review the build settings (leave the generated spec) -> **Save and deploy**. Then add the `staging` branch from **Hosting -> Branches -> Connect branch** if CDK did not create it. Repeat for `<siteId>-reader`. Record the date in the site's runbook. This replaces the PAT in Secrets Manager (`amplify/github-app-token`): after both apps are connected, delete that secret.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 2 ticket)
- Work from a clean worktree of `origin/develop` (`git -C /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus fetch origin && git worktree add ../Papyrus-worktrees/<this-ticket> -b feature/PPY-39f928-<slug> origin/develop`). Never commit to `develop` or `main`; open a PR into `develop`; never merge to `main`. Conventional-commit messages. Update this ticket with branch, PR link and the verification output.
- `AGENTS.md` rules that bind this work: no backward-compatibility shims or fallbacks (clean breaks); backend tooling in Python unless noted; Pretext owns text measurement (do not measure DOM in React); read `AGENTS.local.md` before ANY AWS/Amplify/sandbox command; never run `ampx pipeline-deploy` locally (sandbox only).
- Note on language direction: Ryan's 2026-10-05 correction (epic comment 4174c5) says Papyrus is being ported from Python to TypeScript. Phase 2 follows the approved design in docs/standard-site.md (Python CLI/Lambdas + `papyrus-newsroom`). Keep new Python logic in small pure functions with fixture-driven tests so it can be ported; do not add new Python dependencies beyond those named here.
- Tests: Python unit tests are `unittest` under `procedures/newsroom/tests/` (run: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.<module> -v`); backend Gherkin is `behave` under `features_backend/` with steps in `features_backend/steps/` (run: `poetry run behave features_backend/<file>.feature`); UI Gherkin is cucumber-js + Playwright under `features/` (run against a dev server: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/<file>.feature`); TypeScript unit tests are `scripts/test-*.ts` run with `npx tsx` (add an npm script `test:<name>` in package.json).
- Install: `poetry install --extras "newsroom markus"` and `npm ci`. Verify `markus --version` prints 0.5.1 (PyPI `anthus-markus` 0.5.1 emits IR `schema_version: 1`).
